candidates.summary: Eleven people were killed and 30 injured in an explosion near Aman Mela in the Darazinda area of Dera Ismail Khan, Pakistan, according to emergency service Rescue 1122. The Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan claimed responsibility for the attack.
candidates.title: Blast kills 11 in northwestern Pakistan
candidates.geography: Dera Ismail Khan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan

candidates.summary: Hurricane Polo was a Category 5 storm southwest of Mexico on Saturday morning, with maximum sustained winds reported at 160 mph. Forecasters expected it to turn toward Baja California Sur, where hurricane conditions, life-threatening flooding and mudslides were possible on Monday.
candidates.title: Category 5 Hurricane Polo approaches Baja California Sur

candidates.summary: India's Election Commission ordered a review of its voter-roll software after reporting that internal concerns had been raised about changes that excluded millions of voters. A committee including an independent technology expert will assess whether the software complies with election laws and rules. The commission said its actions were lawful.
candidates.title: India orders review of voter-roll software

candidates.summary: Pope Leo celebrated an outdoor Mass on the Champs-Élysées during his visit to France. The Vatican estimated that about 700,000 people attended, making it the largest event of the four-day tour. Earlier Saturday, he met recently baptized Catholics at the Catholic University of Paris.
candidates.title: About 700,000 attend Pope Leo's Paris Mass
